title: Gap-aware fixed-M005 development reconstruction — 2015 pilot then 2015-2019
hypothesis: The frozen M005 candidate can be reconstructed deterministically on verified 2015-2019 OANDA bid/ask development evidence without synthetic continuity: observation gaps reset indicator and delayed-signal state while preserving any economic position, with explicit executable-price costs and no strategy search.
result: COMPLETED. Stage A semantic/conformance validation passed; Stage B four-pair 2015 technical pilot passed and reproduced byte-for-byte after evidence-layer extension; Stage C unchanged 2015-2019 reconstruction completed across 20 PASS/MATCH evidence shards. 2,274 completed trades and 6,495 gap/reset events reconciled exactly. Economic result is descriptive/falsification evidence only: AUDUSD adverse gross/net; EURUSD net-positive overall but concentrated in 2015; GBPUSD gross-positive overall and in every year but net-negative overall after bid/ask costs; USDJPY near-flat gross and net-negative. No validation/final data, strategy search, sizing, promotion, execution or capital authority.
